title: satk.util.channelstripSt~
description: `satk.util.channelstripSt~` emulates an inline mixer channel strip for a stereo input, providing gain, panning, mute, and stereo output with VU metering. Gain can be set either in linear amplitude (0–1) or dBFS (−20 to +6), while pan ranges from 0 (left) through 0.5 (center) to 1 (right); the module requires the ELSE and CYCLONE libraries.
